title: Priscilla McMillan revealed as CIA asset

tellings.quote: Priscilla McMillan who interviewed U Lee when he went to Russia and also befriended Marina Oswald and wrote her autobiography for her. Um she's a CIA agent. She's a witting CIA asset.

plain: A writer named Priscilla McMillan, who interviewed Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of killing President John F. Kennedy, while he was in Russia, was secretly working for the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency. That is the claim of a researcher named Jeremy Riss, who says McMillan also befriended Oswald's wife, Marina Oswald, and wrote her life story for her, and calls her "a witting CIA asset", meaning she knew she was serving the agency. Riss names no single source but points to the JFK files, the government records on the Kennedy killing. If he is right, the agency had someone close to Oswald and his wife between 1959 and 1963.
